question: Should OpenClaw accept this ACP node-backed runtime only after a SQLite-backed store redesign and explicit gateway-node security sign-off, or should the branch pause or be replaced?
rationale: The PR introduces durable runtime storage plus new paired-node execution commands, so implementation repair alone cannot settle the storage and trust-boundary acceptance decision.

options.title: Require redesign before merge
options.body: Keep the PR open but require a current-main rebase, SQLite-backed storage, security review, and real paired-node proof before merge.

options.title: Accept as explicit experiment
options.body: Allow the runtime behind a non-default experimental path while maintainers explicitly own the storage and security-boundary risks.

options.title: Pause or replace
options.body: Pause this stale branch and sponsor a narrower replacement if the rebase and storage redesign would discard most of the diff.

recommendation.title: Require redesign before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open but require a current-main rebase, SQLite-backed storage, security review, and real paired-node proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent history across the ACP, gateway, and node-host surfaces affected by the decision.
